Positive antinuclear antibodies are detected (titre 1/640), with native anti-DNA antibodies also positive; Anti-Sm negative. What would be the initial treatment of choice for this patient?

                    ### Options

opb. Glucocorticoids and mycophenolate.
opc. Non-steroidal and antimalarial anti-inflammatories.
opd. The picture will probably be self-limiting and does not require treatment.
